verdict.rationale: Fireflies has limited multi-item operations. The MCP tool fireflies_move_meeting moves up to 5 meetings at a time, and fireflies_share_meeting shares a single meeting with up to 100 recipients. The GraphQL transcripts query can fetch filtered lists of transcripts in one request, but that is bulk reading, not bulk mutation. Missing for 10: bulk mutation APIs beyond the 5-meeting move cap, bulk delete/update/tag operations, batch upload or batch GraphQL mutation docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
